sql:
SELECT
  CAST(strftime('%Y', published_at) AS INTEGER) AS publication_year,
  COUNT(posting_key) AS open_remote_us_listings
FROM
  fct_posting
WHERE
  is_open = TRUE
  AND remote_us = TRUE
  AND published_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY
  publication_year
ORDER BY
  publication_year;
